notification.subject: Something new in eimir.
notification.body:
There is something new for you.

Open eimir.: {url}
auth.magic.subject: Your sign-in link for eimir.
auth.magic.body:
Here is your sign-in link:

{url}

It is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.

If you did not request it, you can ignore this message.
auth.signup.subject: Your link for eimir.
auth.signup.body:
Use this link to continue in eimir.:

{url}

It is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.

If you did not request it, you can ignore this message. Nothing happens without the link.
auth.verification.subject: Confirm your email address
auth.recovery.subject: Reset your password
auth.recovery.body:
Use this link to set a new password:

{url}

It is valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once. Afterwards, all previously signed-in devices will be signed out.

If you did not request it, nothing changes.
